R;L pair
not modeled; connects pulmonary trunk bifurcation/left pulmonary artery (SRC_Z_BIFURCATION_OF_PULMONARY_TRUNK, SRC_Z_LEFT_PULMONARY_ARTERY) to SRC_Z_AORTIC_ARCH

items.note: base = posterior surface formed mainly by LA (FJ2438) and part of RA (FJ2439)
items.custom_note: Built for this tool (human-heart equivalent). Posterior surface formed mainly by the LA and the posterior RA.

items.note: groove between atrial walls (FJ2438/FJ2439) and Wall of ventricle FJ2428; holds RCA FJ2723, circumflex, coronary sinus FJ2655

items.note: anterior & posterior grooves on Wall of ventricle FJ2428; hold LAD (FJ2631) and PDA (FJ2692-FJ2700)
items.custom_note: Built for this tool (human-heart equivalent). Anterior and posterior grooves on the ventricular surface over the septum.

items.note: RA wall+cavity, LA wall+cavity

items.note: right auricle not separate; part of Wall of right atrium FJ2439
items.custom_note: Built for this tool (human-heart equivalent). Anterosuperior ear of the RA wall (patch).

items.note: ridge on inner wall of RA FJ2439 between SVC and IVC openings
